profile.headline: Software Engineer at One

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Upgraded daily file ingestion process, integrated an API to enable 800k+ customers to access their worked hours in
real time.
• Executed a $2 million banking partner migration, working with bank ops, product, support, and other teams to move
12,000 customers’ funds quickly and compliantly.
• Coordinated with stakeholders and product managers to design, define, and implement a data abstraction and
caching system for 50+ daily files using PostgreSQL that simplified our backend and saved network resources.
• Managed and maintained 11 partner integrations consisting of over three million active employees.
• Migrated a platform as a service that calls 3rd party APIs to an internal API without data loss or downtime.

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description:
• Onboarded two new vendors by writing Go code to configure their customizable integration and process employee
file data of thousands of employees.
• Developed tools with Typescript and React, allowing client success to self-serve, saving engineers 10 hours weekly.
• Collaborated with customer support to address and fix bugs customers were experiencing with the app and their data.

positions.title: Sr Associate Software Application Engineer
positions.description:
• Created a custom Slack chatbot using Java and Python, which was used by 10,000+ internal employees.
• Built and deployed multiple Docker images to Kubernetes in our IBM Cloud environment.
• Converted our monolith application to a microservices architecture to allow for future extendibility of more chat channels.
• Ensured that all of our processes that involve PII data follows GDPR.
• Reduced tier 1 support cases by 50% year-over-year with this custom Slack bot.

positions.title: Associate Software Application Engineer
positions.description:
• Helped design a new hire to workmate matching application from initial design to deployment.
• Wrote and deployed multiple AWS Lambda functions Java functions.
• Used Terraform to orchestrate our AWS infrastructure in a repeatable way.
• Worked with 3rd party vendors to gather requirements and create Workday integrations for all of Workday's 10,000+ employee's.

positions.title: Forensics and Security Technology Club - Lead Web Developer
positions.description: I am currently the Lead Web Developer for the Forensics and Security Technology club at Cal Poly Pomona which is the largest Cyber Security organization on campus.I keep the clubs website up-to-date with the constantly changing calendar and elected board, and manage the campus wide Capture the Flag Competition that occurs every quarter with around 55 people attending regularly.

company.name: Forensics And Security Technology - Cal Poly FAST

positions.title: QA Analyst Trainee
positions.description:
• I used Visual Basic to code and automate a tedious Excel process that talks to a database, increasing the
efficiency of the task by 300%.
• Found obscure and rare defects before the feature was published to millions of users.
• Practice Agile / Scrum Methodologies.

positions.title: Quality Assurance Intern
positions.description:
• Wrote two scripts to reduce the time it took to parse and fill in data by 200%.
• Used SOAP UI to parse data from API calls made to our different services.
• Found 4 major defects before releases that would have completely stopped customers from purchases
insurance, and 40+ over a year and a half.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Used Go’s asynchronous capabilities to decrease the duration of a network scanning software from
exponential increasing time to a constant time.
• Design and implement software that is maintainable, testable, and efficient by designing and completely
understanding the software I am working with.

projects.title: CPP Capture the Flag Competion
projects.description:
• Lead Web Developer where I helped manage and run our Capture the Flag Cyber Security competition,
and have overseen the deployment at multiple public events with 50+ people.
• Implemented a file proxy in Python to allow competitors to download necessary files with a link that expires.
• Developed multiple custom fixes and solutions to the open source code for our specific use case.
• Manage our infrastructure on Amazon AWS with EC2 instances and S3 buckets, and migrate the client to
physical servers on campus.

projects.title: myCircle API
projects.description:
• Uses ASP.NET Core to build a Rest API using .Net and C# coding principles.
• Configured the application to use Docker and production implementation of keeping secrets.
• Designed the infrastructure for entire backend for chat messages, history, and permissions.

organizations.name: Forensics and Security Techonology
organizations.description: I am the Web Developer for FAST which manages the clubs website and the Capture the Flag Competition. I moved the clubs website from a shared hosting site to Amazon AWS while updating the the website with current up-to-date information. The Capture the Flag Competition is also managed by which which is run every quarter.
